data.name: Mousam
data.gender_notes: Mousam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mousam is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mūsaka' meaning 'wind'. In Hindu mythology, Mousam is considered the god of winds and is believed to bring rain and prosperity. The name Mousam carries the meaning “God of Winds” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mousam usually hope their child will grow to embody god of winds and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of nature and the ability to bring change and growth.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mousam total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mousam holds significant cultural importance in Hindu mythology as it is believed to represent the god of winds. In Hindu tradition, winds are considered auspicious as they bring rain which is essential for agriculture and prosperity. Mousam is also considered to be the god of seasons, and his arrival signifies the change of seasons and the onset of new beginnings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mousam can be seen as a reminder of the cyclical nature of life. Just as the wind brings the much-needed rain, it also signifies change and the arrival of new opportunities. It can be considered a symbol of adaptability and resilience, encouraging individuals to embrace change and find joy in the journey of life.
